## Field

## Official source evidence

Do not substitute an aggregator value for authoritative evidence.

## Expected disposition

Choose the closest:

- [ ] Verified correction
- [ ] Missing value should remain null
- [ ] Provisional value needs clearer labeling
- [ ] Official-source conflict should be preserved
- [ ] Freshness/source label appears wrong
- [ ] Other

## Notes
